title: gypsophila polygonoides subsp. thymifolia
intro: Gypsophila polygonoides subsp. thymifolia, commonly known as creeping gypsophila, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the carnation family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects that provide health benefits such as reducing fever and soothing skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of creeping gypsophila include its ability to calm the nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
